authorization.request: 用户要求修复 DSH Desktop 插件商城安装后无法稳定滚动和查找、目录少于官网的问题；此前已明确要求推送发布。

objective: 让 DSH Desktop 插件商城按 dsh.store/plugins/ 展示完整已知目录，修复列表滚动和全量搜索，并清晰展示 Store 收录/审核状态；安装结果仍由 DSH Desktop 官方插件管理器决定。

directorySources.discovery: registry/discovery-index.json, 19,345 records; source license and attribution retained
directorySources.catalog: registry/catalog.json and SHA-256-pinned registry/catalog-index.json, 875 records: 33 approved, 746 blocked, 96 unlisted
directorySources.websiteMerge: marketplace/lib/plugin-directory.js; same local snapshot yields 20,025 rows, 962 Catalog-linked, 19,063 unlisted, 46 categories

gates: The fresh plan binds base Commit 734769fc3fe45996d9909e47baea3223788ba37e, exact file scope, and base SHA-256 values; CI runs the plan verifier.

Desktop reads bounded GitHub Raw sources with the published Pages mirror as fallback. It validates source URLs, schemas and counts; verifies the Catalog index byte count and SHA-256 against catalog.json; and never treats an incomplete fallback as the full directory.

The merged Desktop directory matches website identity deduplication and includes all valid public discovery rows plus Catalog-only and candidate-only records. Category, Catalog listing/review status, search, sorting and pagination operate across the merged rows.
A bounded independent vertical scroll region contains only the results grid; search and filters remain outside it. Host panel scrolling remains a root-level fallback.

Only approved or blocked Catalog records with a valid fixed GitHub Commit and safe install identity expose the existing confirmed DSH install path. Unlisted, candidate-only and discovery-only rows remain browse-only. DSH Desktop remains authoritative for actual compatibility and installation outcome.
Run disposable Desktop tests, npm run check, static marketplace build, npm pack dry run and git diff --check. Require exact-head PR CI before merge.

After source merge, create a new Catalog policy plan bound to the merged source Commit; independently verify GitHub Raw, Pages, dsh.store and dsh-store.cn. Do not infer real Desktop UI or Profile acceptance from fixture tests.
rollback: Revert only this source change through a CI-checked PR. The separate Catalog remains on 0.9.26 until a fresh policy plan publishes 0.9.27. No real DSH Profile or package mutation is included.
healthCheck: Require the exact-head source PR checks and all four public readbacks after the separate Catalog policy workflow. Keep real DSH Desktop UI and Profile acceptance as separate evidence gates.
